messages:
Ava (docs): Quick heads-up — I opened a docs PR that adds a small footnote for Brazil and Hong Kong data residency in the Regions page, and updates the SDK examples to include the region header. Can folks scan for phrasing/legal tone and check the code snippet? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2143 :eyes:

Ben (i18n): Thanks — will check the translation impact. Prefer 'data residency may apply' vs 'data is stored' for non-committal wording. Also need a localized example for pt-BR?

Marco (SDK): I pulled the branch. The JS snippet currently shows `fetch('/v1/generate', { headers: { 'X-Region': 'eu-west-1' } })` — we should use the canonical header name `X-Redwood-Region` and show both env var + header pattern. Small suggestion: 
```
// set via env or per-request
const REDWOOD_REGION = process.env.REDWOOD_REGION || 'us-east-1'
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-13b', region: REDWOOD_REGION })
// or per-request header
fetch('/v1/generate', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer $TOKEN', 'X-Redwood-Region': 'eu-west-1' }, body: JSON.stringify({ prompt }) })
```

Carla (legal): On the footnote itself — avoid implying residency guarantees. Suggest: "Data residency options are available in select regions; customers should consult their contract or account team for guarantees and audit logs." Also add a link to the Private deployment page and to our SLA doc.

Ava (docs): Good catch on header name, Marco; I'll swap to `X-Redwood-Region` and add the env var example. Carla — reworded as suggested and added links to Private & SLA. Ben — can you add a short Portuguese footnote? Just 1–2 lines, not full doc.

Ben (i18n): On it. Quick draft for pt-BR: "Opções de residência de dados estão disponíveis em regiões selecionadas; consulte seu contrato ou equipe de conta para garantias e logs de auditoria." Pinging localization reviewer for a sanity check. :thumbsup:

DocsBot: Preview site built for pr/2143 — https://deploy-preview-redwood-docs.netlify.app/pr-2143/regions.html

Marco (SDK): One more runtime detail — for Dedicated customers the region header is ignored (routing is by capacity pool). Can we add a short parenthetical: `(Note: Dedicated capacity customers should use their account-configured pool; per-request region header is for Hosted/Private control plane routing.)`

Ava (docs): Adding that parenthetical. Also cleaned up the example to remove hardcoded model name. Will push an update in ~30m. If nobody objects, I'll merge after Ben's pt-BR confirmation and Carla's final wording.

Carla (legal): LGTM pending the link to the SLA page.

Ben (i18n): PT-BR reviewed by localization lead, small tweak made. ✅

Ava (docs): Update pushed: switched header name, added env var snippet, added Dedicated parenthetical, and linked to Private & SLA. Going to merge in 15 unless objections. :rocket:
